## Principle Component Analysis

### Setting up environment

#### Library and Data Upload

```{r Setting_Up_Enviroment, include=FALSE,warning=FALSE}

####Library Loading####
library("edgeR")
library("ggplot2")
library("tibble")
library("dplyr")
library("ggrepel")
library("readr")
library("org.Hs.eg.db")
library("AnnotationDbi")
library("pheatmap")
library("Cormotif")
library("tidyverse")
library("workflowr")
library("RUVSeq")
library("SummarizedExperiment")
library("readxl")
library("ggfortify")
library("ComplexHeatmap")

# BiocManager::install("VennDiagram")


#Loading objects used in this workbook
RNA_Metadata <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/RNA_Metadata.RDS")
RNA_Metadata_No4 <- readRDS("data/QC/concat/RNA_Metatdata_No4.RDS")
RNA_Metadata_No5 <- readRDS("data/QC/concat/RNA_Metatdata_No5.RDS")

RNA_Metadata_No4_NoRep <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/RNA_Metadata_No4_NoRep.RDS")
RNA_Metadata_No5_NoRep <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/RNA_Metadata_No5_NoRep.RDS")

ann_colors <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/ann_colors.RDS")
ann_colors_No4 <- readRDS("data/QC/concat/ann_colors_No4.RDS")
ann_colors_No5 <-readRDS("data/QC/concat/ann_colors_No5.RDS")

RNA_log2cpm <-readRDS("data/QC/concat/RNA_log2cpm.RDS")
RNA_log2cpm_No4 <-readRDS("data/QC/concat/RNA_log2cpm_No4.RDS")
RNA_log2cpm_No5 <-readRDS("data/QC/concat/RNA_log2cpm_No5.RDS")
Filt_RMG0_RNA_log2cpm <- readRDS("data/QC/concat/Filt_RMG0_RNA_log2cpm.RDS")
Filt_RMG0_RNA_log2cpm_No4 <- readRDS("data/QC/concat/Filt_RMG0_RNA_log2cpm_No4.RDS")
Filt_RMG0_RNA_log2cpm_NoD5 <- readRDS("data/QC/concat/Filt_RMG0_RNA_log2cpm_No5.RDS")
Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_log2cpm <- readRDS("data/QC/concat/Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_log2cpm.RDS")
Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_log2cpm_No4 <- readRDS("data/QC/concat/Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_log2cpm_No4.RDS")
Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_log2cpm_No5 <- readRDS("data/QC/concat/Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_log2cpm_No5.RDS")
Filt_FilterByExpression_RNA_log2cpm <-readRDS("data/QC/concat/Filt_FilterByExpression_RNA_log2cpm.RDS")
Filt_FilterByExpression_RNA_log2cpm_No4 <- readRDS("data/QC/concat/Filt_FilterByExpression_RNA_log2cpm_No4.RDS")
Filt_FilterByExpression_RNA_log2cpm_No5 <-readRDS("data/QC/concat/Filt_FilterByExpression_RNA_log2cpm_No5.RDS")


```

### Unfiltered

#### PC1-PC2

#### All

```{r RNA_Unfiltered_PCA, fig.height=6,fig.width=8}

RNA_fc <- readRDS("data/QC/concat/RNA_fc.RDS")

metadata <- RNA_Metadata
counts <- RNA_fc
  

# Make sure metadata follows the count matrix
metadata <- metadata[
    match(colnames(counts), metadata$SampleName),
]

metadata <- metadata %>% 
  filter(Individual != "H4R")

counts <- counts %>% 
  dplyr::select(-contains("R"))

metadata$dgelist <- c(rep(c("Human_Day0","Human_Day2","Human_Day4","Human_Day5","Human_Day15","Human_Day30","Chimp_Day0","Chimp_Day2","Chimp_Day4","Chimp_Day5","Chimp_Day15","Chimp_Day30"),7))

#create DGEList object
dge <- DGEList(counts = counts)
dge$samples$group <- factor(metadata$dgelist)
dge <- normLibSizes(dge, method = "TMM")
dge$samples

dim(dge)
dge$samples

log2cpm <- cpm(dge, log=TRUE)

# Match metadata rows to the order of RNA_log2cpm columns 
metadata <- metadata[ match(colnames(log2cpm), metadata$SampleName), ] 

# Check that all samples matched 
stopifnot(all(metadata$SampleName == colnames(log2cpm))) 

# Optional: check for missing metadata 
stopifnot(!any(is.na(metadata$SampleName)))

prcomp_log2cpm <- prcomp(t(log2cpm), scale=FALSE, center = TRUE)
prcomp_log2cpm_meta <- prcomp_log2cpm$x %>% cbind(., metadata)
#PCA checks
#k=1

prcomp_log2cpm_meta$Timepoint <- factor(prcomp_log2cpm_meta$Timepoint, levels = c("Day0","Day2","Day4","Day5","Day15","Day30"))

ggplot2::autoplot(prcomp_log2cpm ,
                  data = prcomp_log2cpm_meta,
                  colour = "Timepoint",
                  shape = "Species",
                  size = 4,
                  x=1,
                  y=2) +
  scale_color_manual(values=ann_colors$timepoint_cor)+
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(label = metadata$Individual,
                            vjust = -0.5,
                            max.overlaps = 50)+
  ggtitle("PC1 v. PC2 \nTMM - UnFiltered RNA-Seq Log2CPM")

ggplot2::autoplot(prcomp_log2cpm ,
                  data = prcomp_log2cpm_meta,
                  colour = "Timepoint",
                  shape = "Species",
                  size = 4,
                  x=2,
                  y=3) +
  scale_color_manual(values=ann_colors$timepoint_cor)+
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(label = metadata$Individual,
                            vjust = -0.5,
                            max.overlaps = 50)+
  ggtitle("PC2 v. PC3 \nTMM - UnFiltered RNA-Seq Log2CPM")

ggplot2::autoplot(prcomp_log2cpm ,
                  data = prcomp_log2cpm_meta,
                  colour = "Timepoint",
                  shape = "Species",
                  size = 4,
                  x=3,
                  y=4) +
  scale_color_manual(values=ann_colors$timepoint_cor)+
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(label = metadata$Individual,
                            vjust = -0.5,
                            max.overlaps = 50)+
  ggtitle("PC3 v. PC4 \nTMM - UnFiltered RNA-Seq Log2CPM")





prcomp_log2cpm <- prcomp(t(log2cpm), scale=TRUE, center = TRUE)
prcomp_log2cpm_meta <- prcomp_log2cpm$x %>% cbind(., metadata)
#PCA checks
#k=1

prcomp_log2cpm_meta$Timepoint <- factor(prcomp_log2cpm_meta$Timepoint, levels = c("Day0","Day2","Day4","Day5","Day15","Day30"))

ggplot2::autoplot(prcomp_log2cpm ,
                  data = prcomp_log2cpm_meta,
                  colour = "Timepoint",
                  shape = "Species",
                  size = 4,
                  x=1,
                  y=2) +
  scale_color_manual(values=ann_colors$timepoint_cor)+
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(label = metadata$Individual,
                            vjust = -0.5,
                            max.overlaps = 50)+
  ggtitle("PC1 v. PC2 \nTMM - UnFiltered RNA-Seq Log2CPM \nscale=TRUE")

ggplot2::autoplot(prcomp_log2cpm ,
                  data = prcomp_log2cpm_meta,
                  colour = "Timepoint",
                  shape = "Species",
                  size = 4,
                  x=2,
                  y=3) +
  scale_color_manual(values=ann_colors$timepoint_cor)+
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(label = metadata$Individual,
                            vjust = -0.5,
                            max.overlaps = 50)+
  ggtitle("PC2 v. PC3 \nTMM - UnFiltered RNA-Seq Log2CPM \nscale=TRUE")

ggplot2::autoplot(prcomp_log2cpm ,
                  data = prcomp_log2cpm_meta,
                  colour = "Timepoint",
                  shape = "Species",
                  size = 4,
                  x=3,
                  y=4) +
  scale_color_manual(values=ann_colors$timepoint_cor)+
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(label = metadata$Individual,
                            vjust = -0.5,
```

```{r RNA_lcpm_G1_HalfSpeciesTimepoint_PCA_No4_PC1, fig.height=6,fig.width=8}

prcomp_log2cpm_meta <- prcomp_log2cpm_meta %>%
  mutate(Intended_Marker_Expression = case_when(
    Timepoint == "Day0"  ~ `OCT3/4`,
    Timepoint == "Day2"  ~ Brachy,
    Timepoint == "Day5"  ~ `ISL-1`,
    Timepoint == "Day15" ~ `TNNT-2`,
    Timepoint == "Day30" ~ `TNNT-2`,
    TRUE                 ~ NA_real_
  ))


prcomp_log2cpm_meta <- prcomp_log2cpm_meta %>% 
  mutate(Intended_Marker_Level = case_when(
    Intended_Marker_Expression > 85  ~ "High",
    Intended_Marker_Expression > 70 & Intended_Marker_Expression <= 85 ~ "Moderate",
    Intended_Marker_Expression > 55 & Intended_Marker_Expression <= 70 ~ "Low",
    Intended_Marker_Expression <= 55 ~ "VeryLow"
  ))


# Test if Timepoint significantly drives variance on PC1
anova_timepoint <- aov(PC1 ~ Timepoint, data = prcomp_log2cpm_meta)
summary(anova_timepoint)

# Test if Species significantly drives variance on PC1
```

```{r RNA_RMG0_PCA_No4, fig.height=6,fig.width=8}
RMG0_RNA_fc_No4 <- readRDS("data/QC/concat/Filt_RMG0_RNA_fc_No4.RDS")

    match(colnames(counts), metadata$SampleName),
]

  filter(Individual != "H4R")

counts <- counts %>% 
  dplyr::select(-contains("R"))

metadata$dgelist <- c(rep(c("Human_Day0","Human_Day2","Human_Day5","Human_Day15","Human_Day30","Chimp_Day0","Chimp_Day2","Chimp_Day5","Chimp_Day15","Chimp_Day30"),7))

dge <- normLibSizes(dge, method = "TMM")
dge$samples

dim(dge)
dge$samples

# Match metadata rows to the order of RNA_log2cpm columns 
metadata <- metadata[ match(colnames(log2cpm), metadata$SampleName), ] 

# Check that all samples matched 
stopifnot(all(metadata$SampleName == colnames(log2cpm)))
```
